suite: MULTIPATH V3 — Mandatory Authentication Enforcement & Provider Verification

tests.actualResult: Homepage loads cleanly; hero title, 4 epistemic paths, and public landing components render

tests.scenario: Attempt to open curriculum library without a session
tests.expectedResult: Remain on homepage; display sign-in requirement dialog
tests.actualResult: Navigation intercepted by application route guard; remains on homepage; AuthModal displayed with reason banner

tests.scenario: Directly navigate to a protected workspace
tests.actualResult: openTopic() intercepted; active view remains home; AuthModal triggers with workspace access requirement

tests.expectedResult: Protected functionality remains inaccessible; no flash of protected content
tests.actualResult: Session resolves to null; isLoading state prevents protected content flash; route guard resets view to home
Popstate navigation to non-home tab intercepted by AppContent route guard effect; forces currentTab to home and cleans URL history

tests.scenario: Sign in with a valid email/password test account
tests.expectedResult: Authenticated access granted; protected curriculum and workspace unlock
tests.actualResult: Session tokens returned; user profile loaded; navigation guard unlocks tabs; workspace active

tests.expectedResult: Clear error displayed; remain unauthenticated; no route bypass
tests.actualResult: Returns HTTP 400 'Invalid login credentials'; UI error banner displays message; session remains null

tests.scenario: OAuth initiation for configured & custom providers
tests.expectedResult: Produces valid authorization redirect URLs with correct provider query parameters
tests.actualResult: Generated valid authorize URLs for google, facebook, twitter, and custom:instagram

tests.expectedResult: Safe recovery without false success or UI hang
tests.actualResult: Gateway returns HTTP 400 validation_failed; client catches error and remains on safe unauthenticated prompt

tests.expectedResult: Valid session restored; remain on protected workspace
tests.actualResult: Supabase client automatically hydrates session from token storage; protected route guard permits access

tests.expectedResult: Protected access revoked immediately; redirect to home
tests.actualResult: Session cleared; route guard immediately resets currentTab to home; lock icons restored

tests.scenario: Attempt access to another user's records (Empirical RLS verification)
tests.expectedResult: Denied by Row Level Security (RLS); cross-account queries and updates return 0 records even when row demonstrably exists
tests.actualResult: Account A record confirmed in DB (1 row read); Account B query returns 0 rows (RLS read isolation); Account B update returns 0 rows affected (RLS write isolation)

tests.scenario: Attempt to use guest vault for protected learning
tests.expectedResult: Denied; guest flags in local storage cannot bypass session checks
tests.actualResult: Navigation controller checks user object existence; guest local storage flag rejected for protected access

tests.expectedResult: Protected access denied; user redirected to home with recoverable sign-in state
tests.actualResult: Invalid/expired token rejected by auth.getUser(); route guard resets tab to home and surfaces AuthModal

tests.scenario: Registration input validation (short password & invalid email)
tests.expectedResult: Rejects invalid email format and passwords shorter than 6 characters
tests.actualResult: Invalid email rejected with 400 validation error; password < 6 chars rejected with 'Password should be at least 6 characters.'

tests.expectedResult: Preserves anti-enumeration privacy; returns user object with empty identities array
tests.actualResult: Supabase returns HTTP 200 with user object containing empty identities `[]` to prevent account scraping

tests.expectedResult: Unconfirmed registration returns null session or triggers 429 rate limit on confirmation email dispatch
tests.actualResult: User registered in unconfirmed state; session is null or rate-limited with 429 over_email_send_rate_limit, confirming active email verification transport

tests.expectedResult: Uses custom:instagram slug, generates valid authorize URL, and confirms gateway safely rejects unconfigured provider with HTTP 400 (no false session)
tests.actualResult: Authorization URL encodes provider=custom%3Ainstagram; gateway returns HTTP 400 validation_failed ('custom provider custom:instagram not found'); no false session granted
